title: M7.P5: Audit post-candidate16 device and release changes
body:
## Trigger and scope

The original trigger was the ceremony gate and hosted record check 37653236199 reporting 13 completed closures after the accepted #471 audit at 2026-10-07T02:53:02.029760Z: #489, #461, #490, #491, #495, #496, #494, #498, #499, #500, #501, #502, and #504. This owns the newly due review; candidate16 common qualification and #471 remain accepted historical inputs.

Maintainer's standing requirement:
> Ensure that we've done a comprehensive code review and status review of where we are this far, where it's been getting tripped up in the VM checks, and what we need to do to get a workable build with our changes for this version.

Review the post-candidate16 P5 delta and affected interactions: ceremony accounting; storage retention and source custody; administrator dependency-scope correction; host compiler/proof repairs and ARM/FEX/device build ownership; accepted H700/SP adoption evidence; the replacement of cloud-folder migration with explicit manual setup under #508, and the UI/script/QA interactions it changes. #505 was closed not planned after the maintainer chose #508; its isolated diagnostic draft is excluded from shipped-source claims. Include #503/#506's accepted terminal firmware receipts. Do not relabel historical failures or infer personal-cloud success from local pointers.

Scope/depth: scoped Milestone delta, independent depth under code-auditor: primary plus one verified cross-lab reviewer through the Facilitator, with the required blind/refutation passes. This is not a five-seat council. External payloads must exclude ignored personal-device evidence and credentials. No provider transfer has been initiated for this issue; the concrete frozen payload and existing disclosure authority must be checked before dispatch.

Current state (2026-10-08): source-overlay qualification for #508/#510 is complete at distribution6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30 and ES4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e, including qualified #512/#513/#514 fixes. Those product branches remain local/unintegrated; no audit job has started. D-CLOUD-179 reaffirms the post-connection design. Next #515 identifies and qualifies concrete supported progress-file repair cases, then #508 integrates coordinated final inputs. Freeze that resulting source plus its canonical flows/evidence for this audit, including an explicit supported/unsupported repair disposition. The owner-managed Dropbox reset is reported context only and is outside the payload and release gates. The current closure count is read from the live ceremony tool at dispatch; do not reuse the historical trigger count below as current.

Do not mutate the frozen audit scope in parallel or replay the accepted candidate16 VM/audit matrix merely to discharge cadence.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes for changed runtime behavior and diagnostic controls. Host compiler, storage and owner-lifecycle claims use their corresponding sealed host receipts. Already-performed physical observations are reviewed only from authorized retained evidence; no new device or personal-cloud action is part of this audit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The dated running log and input manifest bind the exact baseline, changed source, selected issue criteria and terminal build/proof receipts; coverage explicitly separates preserved candidate16 evidence from newly verified delta behavior.
- [ ] Primary forward/retrospective findings cite code and executed evidence for the changed behaviors and interactions; every finding has a disposition and unresolved claims are not counted as passes.
- [ ] Facilitator receipts verify the required cross-lab reviewer identity and both Milestone passes against the frozen safe payload; the final analysis independently verifies proposed findings.
- [ ] The punch-list index, audit artifact lint and completed marker agree; fixes have affected installed/source verification and no completion is inferred from reviewer prose alone.
- [ ] M7, affected issue bodies and the canonical checkpoint record the resulting readiness and remaining publication/device gates; a fresh exact-head hosted record check consumes the completed audit honestly.
